subject: Mutual Action Plan & evaluation sequencing — Horizon Analytics (timeline risk)
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Caroline Ng <caroline.ng@horizon-analytics.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Mutual Action Plan & evaluation sequencing — Horizon Analytics (timeline risk)

Caroline / Ethan —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Per our discussion I’m attaching the initial mutual action plan (Horizon_MAP_v1.xlsx) and a lightweight evaluation outline (EvalPlan_outline.md). I pulled together the milestones we agreed on and flagged the items I think present the biggest schedule risk:

- Procurement slot availability (legal + security review) — depends on SOC2 evidence and data residency confirmation
- POC acceptance window — typically 2 weeks but can be shortened with a parallel lab test
- Executive signoff — VP-level alignment required before procurement is finalized

Immediate ask: could you confirm whether your procurement team has a standing 1-hour intake meeting or whether we should aim for ad hoc submission? That determines whether the procurement milestone is likely to slip.

Proposed mitigation we discussed on the call: run a short technical POC in parallel with the procurement review (we can lock down a skeleton SOW then execute a POC with sanitized test data). That would shave ~5 business days off the acceptance milestone if procurement runs in parallel.

I’ve shared the HubSpot deal link in case you want to pull the MAP into your internal tracker. If procurement requires a formal SOW before review, we can prepare one and route via DocuSign.

Attachments: Horizon_MAP_v1.xlsx, EvalPlan_outline.md

Thanks — will wait for confirmation on procurement cadence and legal / data residency note.

Best,
Kim
Kimberly Park | Account Executive
Redwood Inference

From: Caroline Ng <caroline.ng@horizon-analytics.com>

Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan & evaluation sequencing — Horizon Analytics (timeline risk)

Kim —

Thanks for the materials and the clear timeline. A couple quick notes from procurement/legal:

- Our legal team needs confirmation on data residency (we host primarily in us-west-2; need to confirm no cross-border processing for PII).
- We have a standing procurement intake every Tuesday at 11am PT, but they only review fully-documented SOWs / vendor questionnaires. If the SOW is missing details we’ll be pushed to the next slot.

That said, we like the idea of running a scoped POC in parallel. If you can provide a 1-page SOW and a brief data handling note today, I’ll submit to procurement for Tuesday.

Caroline
Caroline Ng
Senior Director, Platform Ops | Horizon Analytics
caroline.ng@horizon-analytics.com | +1 206-555-0199
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Dec 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Mutual Action Plan & evaluation sequencing — timeline risk (internal)

Kim / Lauren —

Confirming procurement is the primary slippage vector here. Quick internal notes:

- Option A (low lift): Prepare 1-page SOW + data handling addendum; request procurement slot next Tue.
- Option B (aggressive): Run a short POC in our cloud with synthetic data + provide a technical lab session to Horizon’s infra team (requires SE time; ETA 3 business days to stand up).
- Option C (escalation): If procurement team pushes beyond next Tue, escalate to VP Sales to request a dedicated procurement review window (we’ve done this twice before for mid-market accounts).

I recommend pushing Option B in parallel with Option A. I’ll coordinate with SE to confirm availability and draft the SOW template. Also recommend documenting a simple risk registry entry in the MAP (column added: risk & mitigation).

-Marcus
Marcus Lin | Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Caroline Ng <caroline.ng@horizon-analytics.com>
Cc: Ethan Lau <ethan.lau@horizon-analytics.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Dec 2026 13:26:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Mutual Action Plan & evaluation sequencing — Horizon Analytics (timeline risk)

Caroline —

Appreciate the quick response. Attached is MAP_proposal_v2.xlsx (I’ve added a Risk Registry tab and a tightened evaluation path). Key changes:

- Evaluation split: run parallel lab POC (synthetic data) during procurement review — reduces overall time-to-acceptance by ~5 business days.
- Acceptance milestone: POC acceptance window shortened from 10 to 6 business days (we’ll provide a one-day lab demo).
- Procurement readiness: 1-page SOW and a data residency note included in the attachments for submission to procurement Tuesday.
- Escalation ladder: if procurement misses the Tue slot, we ask for a procurement champion via VP Sales escalation within 48 hours.

Would you be able to confirm by EOD whether procurement will accept a 1-page SOW this week? If yes, I’ll route the SOW + data note and prepare the DocuSign envelope.

Attachments: MAP_proposal_v2.xlsx

Thanks,
Kim
From: Caroline Ng <caroline.ng@horizon-analytics.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ethan Lau <ethan.lau@horizon-analytics.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Dec 2026 14:32:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan & evaluation sequencing — Horizon Analytics (timeline risk)

Kim / Marcus —

We’ll take Option A + B. I confirmed procurement will accept a 1-page SOW for intake this Tuesday; I’ve blocked a 11:00am PT slot on our calendar for the intake review. I’ll submit the SOW as soon as I receive it.

Two items for Redwood to action:

1) Please send the 1-page SOW and the data residency note (even if it’s a short bullet list).
2) If you can prepare the DocuSign envelope for an interim SOW so we can start legal review in parallel, that speeds things up.

If both are submitted today we should keep the current close target. If procurement pushes beyond next Tue we’ll need to escalate per your ladder.

Thanks — looking forward to the POC notes and SOW.

Caroline
